purpose: Audit geographic transportability of the already-authorized RC6 headline; not a new ecological endpoint or mechanism search.
population: The existing 4,236 matched wetter-drier NAAMP comparisons from 585 routes in 21 states.

state_specific_slopes.model: response ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(RunNumber)
state_specific_slopes.interpretation: Direction and effect-size distribution; individual-state significance is not a pass criterion.

leave_one_state_out.model: original RC6 model response ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber)
leave_one_state_out.pass_rule: For each of the three headline responses, all leave-one-state-out rain_contrast coefficients remain positive.
leave_one_state_out.strong_pass_rule: All leave-one-state-out 95% confidence intervals remain above zero for all three headline responses.

state_random_slope.model_family: linear mixed model with State random intercept and rain_contrast random slope; fixed rain_contrast + temperature difference + day-of-year difference + year gap + RunNumber
state_random_slope.role: Quantify geographic heterogeneity; no requirement that every state-specific slope is positive.

decision_language.pass: The RC6 expansion signal is not driven by any single state and is geographically transportable across the sampled NAAMP region, while allowing state-level effect heterogeneity.
decision_language.fail: The continent-scale association remains supported in the pooled matched analysis, but geographic consistency is limited because at least one state materially controls a headline coefficient.
prohibited: the effect occurs in every state
state-specific P<0.05 as a requirement for generality
